item.ptxt: Perform the work after the fluid temperature has dropped to room temperature.
Leave the vehicle for a long time (overnight) after stopping the engine.

s3.ptxt: Refer to the work flow below and follow the procedure.

atten4.ptxt: The fluid filling procedure differs depending on the work performed.

s3.ptxt: If a large amount of fluid is to be added, go to step [*1]
If a small amount of fluid is to be added, go to step [*2]

s2.ptxt: Add fluid (when a large amount of fluid is to be added) [*1]

s3.ptxt: Keeping the vehicle level, lift it up.
Remove engine under cover NO.1.
Remove the engine under cover rear LH.
Using a socket hexagon wrench 6, remove the overflow plug and gasket.
Remove the refill plug and gasket.
Add fluid through the refill hole until fluid flows out of the overflow.

atten3.ptxt: Use Toyota Genuine ATF WS as the fluid to be added.

s3.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 6, temporarily tighten the overflow plug with the gasket.
Add the specified amount of fluid through the refill hole.

entry.ptxt: Related Work
Refill Amount (Reference)
When removing/installing the oil pan or drive shaft, or replacing an oil seal
When removing/installing the torque converter assembly
When the transaxle assembly has been replaced (new torque converter assembly used)
When the transaxle assembly has been replaced (torque converter assembly reused)

atten3.ptxt: The refill amount varies depending on the related work.

s3.ptxt: Temporarily tighten the refill plug with the gasket.
Lower the vehicle.
Go to Oil Temperature Detection Mode Switching (When Terminal TC Is Shorted) [*3]
Go to Oil Temperature Detection Mode Switching (When Using SST (TaSCAN)) [*4]

s2.ptxt: Add fluid (when a small amount of fluid is to be added) [*2]

s3.ptxt: Keeping the vehicle level, lift it up.
Remove engine under cover NO.1.
Remove the engine under cover rear LH.
Remove the refill plug and gasket.
Add the specified amount of fluid through the refill hole.

entry.ptxt: Related Work
Refill Amount (Reference)
When the oil cooler and cooler hoses have been removed
When oil seepage, etc. has been repaired

atten3.ptxt: Use Toyota Genuine ATF WS as the fluid to be added.

s3.ptxt: Temporarily tighten the refill plug with the gasket.
Lower the vehicle.
Go to Oil Temperature Detection Mode Switching (When Terminal TC Is Shorted) [*3]
Go to Oil Temperature Detection Mode Switching (When Using SST (TaSCAN)) [*4]

s2.ptxt: Switch to fluid temperature detection mode (when shorting TC terminal) [*3]

s3.ptxt: Turn IG ON.
Turn the A/C OFF.
Turn IG OFF.
Using SST, connect terminals 13 (TC) and 4 (CG) of DLC3.
Start the engine.
Slowly move the shift lever from the P range to the D range, and then shift back to the P range.
Switch to oil temperature detection mode.

entry.ptxt: Oil Temperature Detection Mode Switching Procedure
Perform the N - D operation within 1.5 seconds
Perform the above operation continuously for 6 seconds or more

s3.ptxt: The meter indicator light [D] illuminates for 2 seconds and then goes off.
Depending on the fluid temperature, the meter indicator light comes on, goes off or blinks.

item.ptxt: Add fluid while the meter indicator light is illuminated.
If the meter indicator light is off, adjust the fluid temperature [*4] to between 40° and C-45°C.
If the meter indicator light is blinking, check the vehicle condition and wait for the fluid temperature to drop before performing the work.

s2.ptxt: Adjust fluid temperature (when shorting TC terminal) [*4]

s3.ptxt: Move the shift lever to the P range.
Disconnect terminals 13 (TC) ←→ 4 (CG) of DLC3.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to open terminal TC, as the fluid level cannot be adjusted accurately unless it is open.

s3.ptxt: Warm up the engine at idle to raise the automatic transaxle fluid temperature.
As soon as the meter indicator light [D] illuminates, lift up the vehicle.

atten3.ptxt: Adjust the fluid level while the meter indicator light is illuminated.

s3.ptxt: Go to Fluid Level Check [*7]

s2.ptxt: Switch to fluid temperature detection mode (when using SST (TaSCAN)) [*5]

s3.ptxt: Connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Start the engine with the A/C OFF.
Select Active Test (TC terminal ON), and turn the TC terminal ON with the A/T fluid temperature displayed.
Slowly move the shift lever from the P range to the D range, and then shift back to the P range.
Switch to oil temperature detection mode.

entry.ptxt: Oil Temperature Detection Mode Switching Procedure
Perform the N - D operation within 1.5 seconds
Perform the above operation continuously for 6 seconds or more

s3.ptxt: The meter indicator light [D] illuminates for 2 seconds and then goes off.
Depending on the fluid temperature, the meter indicator light comes on, goes off or blinks.

item.ptxt: Add fluid while the meter indicator light is illuminated.
If the meter indicator light is off, adjust the fluid temperature [*6] to between 40° and C-45°C.
If the meter indicator light is blinking, check the vehicle condition and wait for the fluid temperature to drop before performing the work.

s3.ptxt: Move the shift lever to the P range.
Turn the TC terminal from ON to OFF.

atten3.ptxt: Be sure to open terminal TC, as the fluid level cannot be adjusted accurately unless it is open.

s3.ptxt: Warm up the engine at idle to raise the automatic transaxle fluid temperature.
As soon as the meter indicator light [D] illuminates, lift up the vehicle.

atten3.ptxt: Adjust the fluid level while the meter indicator light is illuminated.

s3.ptxt: Go to Fluid Level Check [*7]

atten4.ptxt: The fluid level adjustment method differs depending on whether or not the fluid overflows.

s3.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 6, remove the overflow plug and gasket.
Check the fluid condition.

item.ptxt: "Overflow" refers to the condition in which fluid flows out of the overflow tube.
If only a small amount of fluid flows out, it may just be the fluid that had collected in the overflow tube (approximately 1cc), so judge that it is not overflowing.

s3.ptxt: If fluid overflows, go to step [*8]
If fluid does not overflow, go to step [*9]

atten3.ptxt: The drained fluid is hot, so handle it with care.

s3.ptxt: When the fluid flow becomes a trickle, fully tighten the overflow plug with a new gasket.
Fully tighten the refill plug with a new gasket.
Install the engine under cover rear LH.
Install engine under cover NO.1.
Lower the vehicle.
Turn IG OFF and disconnect SST (TaSCAN).

s2.ptxt: Refill fluid (when fluid does not overflow) [*9]

s3.ptxt: Remove the refill plug and gasket.
Add fluid through the refill hole until fluid flows out of the overflow.

atten3.ptxt: Use Toyota Genuine ATF WS as the fluid to be added.

s3.ptxt: When the fluid flow becomes a trickle, fully tighten the overflow plug with a new gasket.
Fully tighten the refill plug with a new gasket.
Install the engine under cover rear LH.
Install engine under cover NO.1.
Lower the vehicle.
Turn IG OFF and disconnect SST (TaSCAN).
